players.product: early and strategic customer of Quantinuum quantum computing, deploying Quantinuum solutions in its products (chemistry)

quarterly_data.signal: Honeywell 10-Q amendment (filed to correct the segment backlog misaligned in the July 23 filing): backlog increased 12% to $38.0 billion at June 30, 2026 - Aerospace Technologies $18,435 million, Building Automation $9,258 million, Process Automation and Technology $7,640 million, Industrial Automation $2,675 million, total $38,008 million.

Honeywell 10-Q amendment: Quantinuum, a former consolidated subsidiary, completed its IPO on June 4, 2026; Honeywell retained a 48% noncontrolling ownership interest, now accounted for as an equity method investment (Quantinuum deconsolidated in Q2 2026). After the Aerospace spin-off Honeywell Technologies manages three reportable segments: Building Automation, Process Automation and Technology, and Industrial Automation.
